meaning: Topic/candidate-friction mentions, not automatically negative or substantive; English-heavy with a few Romanised Hindi expressions.

rules.technical_friction: \b(?:crash\w*|glitch\w*|buffer\w*|lag(?:ging|gy|s)?|stutter\w*|freez\w*|bug(?:s)?|re-?install\w*|black screen|not (?:work\w*|play\w*|load\w*|open\w*)|(?:can.?t|cannot|won.?t|doesn.?t|don.?t|unable to)\s+(?:even\s+)?(?:play|watch|open|load)|keeps\s+(?:load\w*|stop\w*)|video stops|only audio|poor quality|brightness problem|endless loading|breaks the stream)\b
rules.catalogue_gaps: \b(?:missing|not available|unavailable|removed|remove shows|no variety|catalog(?:ue)?.{0,20}limited|more (?:regional|movies|shows)|wider selection|(?:don.?t|doesn.?t) have.{0,30}(?:movies?|shows?|series|seasons?|episodes?|titles?)|set a reminder|stream.{0,30}back|all movies in|give us the show|other streaming channels|content gets less)\b
rules.discovery_controls: \b(?:search|recommend\w*|fast forward|rewind|double tap|fit.{0,5}screen|zoom|resume|last played|continue watching|landscape|can.?t read|upcoming|cast(?:ing)?|roku|chromecast|not interested|re-?download|download(?:ing|s)?|white light|too much sound)\b

development: Pilot reading and 100 hash-sampled development reviews; no statistical model fitted. V2 narrows catalogue phrases and requires show context for ambiguous programme words after the audit and evidence check.
denominator: All nonblank text reviews in the specified app/window. Different from earlier proposed substantive-only denominator, which cannot yet be reliably assigned.
